description: This source file defines the React component and context logic for integrating the Convex client into a React frontend application. It manages the creation of the Convex client, provides context access, and handles user synchronization with Convex backend using Clerk sessions, including upserting user data on sign-in and profile updates.

methods.name: useConvexClient
methods.description: Hook to access the Convex client instance from context.

methods.name: AppConvexProvider
methods.description: Component that provides Convex client context to its children and manages user upsert logic based on Clerk authentication state.
